title: Algerian-Style Salad with Light Dressing
description: A refreshing Algerian-inspired salad with a light and tangy dressing. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Algerian
ingredients.notes: such as kale, spinach, and arugula

ingredients.name: light
ingredients.notes: use a light olive oil for a lighter dressing

ingredients.name: peas
ingredients.notes: fresh peas can be used if in season

ingredients.name: salad
ingredients.notes: use a variety of colored cherry tomatoes for a pop of color

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use kosher salt or sea salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: pepper
ingredients.notes: use freshly ground black pepper for best flavor

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: use fresh lemon juice for best flavor

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: use fresh garlic for best flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, frozen peas, cherry tomatoes, salt, and pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
